name: Automated-Post-Bot
headline: Automated-post bot for social media managers
short_description: An intelligent social media automation tool that generates, validates, and publishes engaging content to LinkedIn and Twitter using AI. Built with LangGraph for workflow orchestration and powered by Google's Gemini AI.
author: connect-abdullah

sections.overview:
Automated-Post-Bot is a social media automation tool that orchestrates content generation, validation, and publishing across LinkedIn and Twitter using LangGraph and Google's Gemini AI. The bot generates discussion-worthy tech topics, creates platform-specific content (professional posts for LinkedIn, concise threads for Twitter), validates content against platform guidelines, and publishes with automatic retry logic. It handles multi-platform posting simultaneously, includes community posting for Twitter, and provides human approval for generated topics. This tool is designed for content creators, tech professionals, and teams seeking to automate consistent social media engagement without manual posting.
Automate daily social media posting for tech professionals and thought leaders
Generate and publish consistent LinkedIn and Twitter content from a single workflow
Post to Twitter communities while maintaining follower engagement
Validate content compliance before publishing across multiple platforms
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/connect-abdullah/Automated-Post-Bot`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 3-part LinkedIn post series for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The posts should be engaging, informative, and tailored to [COMPANY]'s brand voice. Include relevant hashtags and optimize for LinkedIn's algorithm. Ensure the content is based on [DATA] or recent trends in the industry. Publish the first post immediately, schedule the second for 2 days later, and the third for 5 days after that.
```
